comparison.objective: Reload a spring-loaded long-arm stapler and staple two sheets; the candidate commissions a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests holding a sprung drawer open, orienting and inserting a staple strip, positioning sheets, and pressing the stapler. Candidate tests tool-in-fastener alignment, loosening, fine rotary adjustment, retightening, and response-driven iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a correctly loaded and shut drawer, a driven staple through both sheets, and arms clear. Candidate requires two repeatable, non-bottoming carriage stops after locking the collar.
comparison.reason: Spring resistance and bimanual holding are generic commonalities; loading consumables and fastening paper do not test dynamic damper tuning or witness-torque retention. Candidate lacks numeric drift, rebound, and overload limits.
